answer: Each agent proves continuous presence by answering timed challenges that drift like a wander across the network horizon. The response is a memory-hard sequential cipher whose state is bound to a unique lotus seed from the identity. The next lotus-dependent step requires the full prior working set to stay resident%2C so clones cannot share memory. An attacker spawning n identities must keep n separate cipher chains resident and advancing with the wander of the horizon%2C paying a strictly linear non-amortizable cost.
